headline: Statistics Sweden Reports Increased Borrowing in Interest-Bearing Securities
summary: Statistics Sweden reported an increase in debt financing via interest-bearing securities across domestic sectors.
why: Debt issuance data in Sweden reflects public and private borrowing appetite and liquidity demand across Scandinavian fixed-income markets.

impacts.name: Sweden 10-year government bond yield
impacts.why: Higher issuance of interest-bearing securities influences secondary market bond supply and yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
